targets.whyItMatters: High-trust web inspiration for composition, motion, hierarchy, and visual craft.
targets.compositionNotes: Prioritize full-screen visual systems, product stages, immersive layouts, and non-card-first pages.
targets.focalObjectNotes: Identify how award sites create desire around one object, scene, product, or story.

targets.whyItMatters: Mobile/product UI references prevent cinematic concepts from breaking real app ergonomics.
targets.compositionNotes: Capture mobile density, navigation, sheet behavior, and first action visibility.
targets.focalObjectNotes: Prioritize screens where the product object remains visible on mobile.
targets.interactionNotes: Document selection, compare, inspect, and configure flows.
targets.attributionNote: Do not bypass Mobbin login or paid access. Keep notes when capture is not allowed.

targets.whyItMatters: Selection-first products need desire, comparison, object swapping, and selected-state clarity.
targets.compositionNotes: Look for rosters, character select screens, loadout systems, galleries, card decks, and comparison rails.
targets.focalObjectNotes: Track whether the selected object stays dominant at 390, 768, and 1440.
targets.interactionNotes: Document hover reward, selected reward, detail reveal, and object swap behavior.
targets.attributionNote: Pinterest is moodboard-only; portfolio/community references require attribution.

targets.whyItMatters: Visual-heavy apps need stagecraft, depth, and emotional hook before product logic.
targets.compositionNotes: Look for staged objects, full-bleed environments, controlled negative space, and motion-led reveals.
